name: Artisanal Sock Sweater
note: The pieced socks are drawn as one layout on front and back with the rib turned from panel to panel; the knitted heel cups at the bust, shoulders and elbows are flat here. Price is a judgement from a wide dealer range.

name: Artisanal Leather Belt Jacket
note: No photograph could be loaded: built from the research description of the 2006 Artisanal piece, which is a sleeveless vest of second-hand belts (the list calls it a jacket). The belts are laid round the body with their buckles down the front; the real layout may differ. Season within 2006 unverified; price is a judgement from comparable Artisanal lots.

name: Doll's Wardrobe Oversized Cardigan
note: The doll's wardrobe is a family; this is the enlarged hand-knit cardigan with its fist-sized press studs, worn over the oversized white shirt whose tail shows below the hem (the tail is a band hung from the cardigan's hem, not the shirt itself). Price is a judgement from auction estimates.

name: Artisanal Reconstructed Denim Coat
note: The SS1991 coat made from a jeans jacket with a pair of jeans opened out below it, as the sleeved example in the Costume Institute. The open inseam at the front is painted dark on a closed skirt, and the wedge let into the back is simplified to one piece. Price is a judgement from dealer and auction ranges.

name: Cyberbaba Op-Art Mesh Top
note: The dot-matrix version of the Cyberbaba body map: the dots are drawn to swell over the chest, stomach and hips on the body, and the sleeves use the regular op-art dots. Painted as opaque ivory jersey, not sheer mesh: the net's holes broke the dots up. The lettuce-edged hems are plain.

name: Psych Girl Mesh Top
note: No Gaultier piece is known by the name 'Psych Girl'; this is the SS2000 mesh top with a melting psychedelic girl's face, which is what the name describes. The mesh is drawn opaque.

name: Les Tatouages Mesh Top
note: The mesh is drawn as an opaque flesh tone of its own, so the tattoos read on any wearer.

name: Trompe-l'œil Body Print Top
note: No photograph could be loaded; drawn from the description: a life-size torso in brick-red halftone on a flesh-coloured ground.

name: Bumster Trousers
note: The shiny grey suiting of the first pair; no photograph could be loaded.

name: Highland Rape Tartan Jacket
note: The collection's tailored tartan jacket with green wool sleeves, over torn green lace; no photograph could be loaded.

name: Coffee Table Skirt
note: The table pulled up into its skirt: stepped rings of polished wood. The one made is in a museum; the price is what it might fetch.
